name: ksx-monorepo
description: KSX – Backend TS + Frontend React+TS (converted from static HTML)

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --prefix backend
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run deploy:worker --prefix backend
